description: Nested region-size test: the 4000 pc galaxy (lhs25 with expected_bubbles and civ_birth_rate scaled by 16) cropped to 1000 pc. nested_r4000_c1000, _c2000 and _full share design_seed, n_points and seeds, so they hold the same civs within the crop. LHS over the environment, the strategic make-up of the galaxy and colonization (27 dims). Environment ranges are those of the pilot. Strategy mix: one weight per archetype (config.ARCHETYPES), log-uniform on [0.01, 1] so that galaxies dominated by one or two archetypes are sampled as well as balanced ones; 'random' is the former uniform draw of every trait. strategy_noise spreads civs around their archetype (fraction of each trait's range). artefact_stealth_per_tech: 0 = probes as visible whatever their owner's tech, 5 = a probe 1 tech level above humanity is found exp(-5) as often. Colonization: colonization_launch_period_years, the delay before a settled world launches its own probes (front speed from Carroll-Nellenback et al. 2019, probe speed anchored on Voyager 1 and probe_speed_cap_c); habitable world density per pc^3; tech_population_exponent from tech independent of population (0) to linear returns (1). max_steps is the deterministic budget; run with --time-budget 600 as a wall-clock safety net. Ranges are first guesses, not sourced priors.
